vedic.item.grahas.0.career: Your Lagna (rising sign) is Vrishchika, Scorpio, and it's the lens for your whole working life: intense, private, perceptive, drawn to what's hidden or difficult. Its lord, Mars, is strong in its own sign in your 6th house, the house of service, competition and daily effort. That's a fighter's placement: you do well where there are problems to solve, opponents to outwork and systems to fix. You may be underestimated at first and then trusted completely.

vedic.item.grahas.1.career: The Sun is the karaka (natural signifier) of status and authority, and in your chart it also rules your 10th house, the karma bhava of career. It sits in your 8th house in Mithuna (Gemini), with Jupiter and Venus. The lord of career in the 8th points to work in research, investigation, other people's resources or sensitive matters, and to a career that changes shape more than once, sometimes suddenly. Recognition comes, but often after working behind the scenes.

vedic.item.grahas.2.career: Moon in Meena (Pisces) in the 5th: an intuitive, imaginative mind that does well advising, teaching or creating. As your 9th lord here, it links good fortune to wisdom and learning.

vedic.item.grahas.3.career: Mars, your Lagna lord, in its own sign in the 6th: excellent stamina for hard work, competition and problem-solving. You outwork difficulties; just guard against burning yourself out doing it.

vedic.item.grahas.4.career: Mercury, the planet of skill, trade and communication, sits in Karka (Cancer) in your 9th house of dharma, higher learning and principle. It rules your 8th and 11th houses, so knowledge and research become gains. This suits policy, law, teaching, writing and advice: work where your intellect serves something larger. Your thinking is shaped by feeling and care, so you explain complex things in a way people trust.

vedic.item.grahas.5.career: Jupiter, the guru, sits with your Sun in the 8th house in Mithuna. It rules your 2nd house of wealth and 5th house of intelligence, so wisdom and good counsel are tied to your earnings. In the 8th it gives protection through difficult changes and a gift for deep, research-based advice. It also forms Gaja Kesari yoga with your Moon, a classic sign of good reputation.

vedic.item.grahas.6.career: Venus in the 8th: you do well with shared finances, negotiations and partnerships behind the scenes. Comfort and beauty in your workplace matter more than you admit.

vedic.item.grahas.7.career: Shani, Saturn, is the karaka of work, service and endurance. In your chart it's retrograde in Dhanu (Sagittarius) in your 2nd house of wealth and speech, and rules your 3rd (effort, initiative) and 4th (home, security). Earnings come slowly and through disciplined effort; speech is careful and considered. Saturn here asks you to build wealth patiently and to take your own initiative seriously. You're currently in its sub-period, so these themes are loud right now.

vedic.item.grahas.8.career: Rahu in Makara in the 3rd: ambition for your own voice, media and enterprise. You can be bold in communication and self-promotion when you decide to be.

vedic.item.grahas.9.career: Ketu in the 9th: you may distrust institutions or official teachers, preferring wisdom you've tested yourself. Good for independent thinking.

vedic.item.nak.0.career: Your Lagna is in Jyeshtha, ruled by Mercury, with Indra as deity: the nakshatra of the senior, the protector, the one who takes responsibility and rises through it. At work it gives authority earned through competence and a protective instinct towards the people and systems you're responsible for. Its shadow is taking on too much and feeling you must win every contest; the power here is in rising, not in fighting everyone on the way.

vedic.item.nak.1.career: Your Sun, lord of your career house, is in Punarvasu, ruled by Jupiter, with the goddess Aditi as deity. Punarvasu is the return of the light after the storm: renewal, starting again with wisdom. In career terms, it suggests a path that renews itself, where you can begin again in a new form without losing what you've built. Its power is restoring substance, so you're good at rebuilding things.

vedic.item.nak.2.career: Moon in Revati: a guiding, nourishing mind. You're good at helping people make a safe passage through change, which suits advising and mentoring.

vedic.item.nak.3.career: Mars in Ashwini: quick to act and quick to fix. You're at your best in situations that need fast, effective help.

vedic.item.nak.4.career: Mercury in Pushya: your intellect nourishes. You explain, teach and advise in ways that genuinely support people.

vedic.item.nak.5.career: Jupiter in Punarvasu: wisdom that renews. You're good at helping others start over, and at starting over yourself.

vedic.item.nak.6.career: Venus in Mrigashira: the seeker. You keep looking for the role or partnership that feels right, and curiosity serves you well.

vedic.item.nak.7.career: Saturn, the karaka of work, sits in Uttara Ashadha, ruled by the Sun, with the Vishvadevas (universal gods) as deity. Its power is unchallengeable victory: lasting success won through patience, ethics and endurance. For work, it says that your victories come late and stay won. Effort that follows principle is what Saturn will reward.

vedic.item.nak.8.career: Rahu in Shravana: success through listening and learning. Your edge is hearing what others miss.

vedic.item.nak.9.career: Ketu in Pushya: a quiet, inherited knack for caring and counsel. It comes naturally, so you may undervalue it.

vedic.item.dasha.0.career: You're in the Mahadasha (main period) of the Sun, from September 2023 to September 2029. The Sun is your 10th lord, so these six years put career, authority and recognition at the centre of your life. Because the Sun sits in your 8th house, the period also brings transformation: changes in role or direction, and work that goes deeper. It's a period to step into your own authority.

vedic.item.dasha.1.career: Within it, you're in the Antardasha (sub-period) of Saturn from July 2026 to July 2027. Saturn and the Sun are traditional opponents, so this is a demanding stretch: authority and duty, ambition and patience, pulling against each other. Saturn rules your 3rd house of initiative and sits in your 2nd house of earnings, so the work of this year is disciplined effort to build your own income base. It rewards slow, structured moves and punishes shortcuts.

vedic.item.dasha.2.career: The Mercury Antardasha from July 2027 brings your 11th lord of gains to the fore: a promising time for income, networks and the rewards of skilled advice.

vedic.item.dasha.3.career: The Moon Mahadasha from 2029: a ten-year period favouring advising, teaching and work that nourishes people, led by intuition more than authority.

vedic.item.dasha.4.career: Mars Mahadasha from 2039: energy, competition and drive, through your strong Lagna lord. A period for vigorous work and leadership.

vedic.item.dasha.5.career: Rahu Mahadasha from 2046: ambition, new fields and unconventional paths. Far ahead, but it favours bold reinvention.

vedic.item.yogas.0.career: Gaja Kesari yoga, with Jupiter in a kendra (angle) from your Moon, is one of the classic yogas for reputation, wisdom and the ability to overcome difficulty. For work, it suggests that your name and standing grow over time, especially when you're seen as wise and fair, and that you recover well from setbacks. It's a yoga of respect earned through counsel.

vedic.overview.grahas.overview: Your Lagna is Vrishchika (Scorpio): deep, private, determined. Its lord Mars is powerful in its own sign in your 6th house, which gives stamina, courage and the ability to outlast problems and rivals. The heart of the chart is your 8th house in Mithuna, where the Sun, Jupiter and Venus sit together. The 8th is the house of hidden things, research, shared wealth and transformation, so much of your life force goes into depth, sensitive matters and change. Your Moon in Meena in the 5th gives an intuitive, creative, advising mind, and it forms Gaja Kesari yoga with Jupiter. Mercury in Karka in the 9th ties your intelligence to principle and learning. Saturn in the 2nd, retrograde, makes wealth and speech slow, careful and earned. Rahu in the 3rd fuels ambition for your own voice; Ketu in the 9th makes you question received wisdom.
vedic.overview.grahas.career: For work: the lord of your career house (the Sun) is in the 8th, with Jupiter, so your career is built through depth, trust and research, and changes form more than once. Your strong Mars in the 6th gives the stamina for hard, competitive work. Saturn in the 2nd says income grows through patience and discipline, and Rahu in the 3rd says the time to back your own voice will come. Advisory, analytical and independent work fits this chart well.

vedic.overview.nak.overview: Your nakshatras repeat a few themes. Jyeshtha on the Lagna is the senior protector who rises through responsibility. Your Sun and Jupiter both sit in Punarvasu, the return of the light: renewal, rebuilding, starting again wisely. Three placements (Moon in Revati, Mercury and Ketu in Pushya) carry Mercury's and Saturn's nourishing, guiding quality: helping people through, feeding them what they need. Mars in Ashwini is quick help and healing. Saturn in Uttara Ashadha is lasting victory through ethics and patience. Rahu in Shravana succeeds by listening. Venus in Mrigashira keeps seeking. Together they describe a protector and guide whose strength is renewal and counsel, and whose victories are slow and permanent.
vedic.overview.nak.career: For work, the nakshatras describe a counsellor and protector: someone who rises through responsibility (Jyeshtha), rebuilds and renews (Punarvasu), guides people through change (Revati, Pushya) and wins lasting success through patience (Uttara Ashadha). This favours advisory, teaching and restorative work, and a career that can reinvent itself without losing its foundations.

vedic.overview.dasha.overview: Your Vimshottari timeline puts you in the Mahadasha of the Sun from 2023 to 2029, and within it, the Antardasha of Saturn from July 2026 to July 2027, followed by Mercury from July 2027. After 2029 comes the ten-year Moon Mahadasha, then Mars from 2039 and Rahu from 2046. The Sun period is about authority, self and visibility; Saturn's sub-period inside it is about discipline, duty and patience, and the two planets are traditional opponents. Mercury's sub-period after it is lighter, favouring skill, trade and gains.
vedic.overview.dasha.career: For your career, the Sun Mahadasha is the period to claim your own authority, because the Sun is your 10th lord. The Saturn sub-period (until July 2027) is the hard, structured part of it: building your own base through steady effort, not big leaps. Mercury from July 2027 brings your 11th lord of gains, a better window for income from advice and networks. Plan your effort now and your rewards for 2027–2029.

vedic.career.reading:
Your chart is built for depth, counsel and authority earned slowly. The Sun, lord of your 10th house of career, sits in the 8th house with Jupiter and Venus. That's a career made through research, sensitive information, other people's resources and transformation: work behind the scenes that eventually brings you recognition. The 8th also tends to reshape careers more than once, so a change of form is part of your path, not a sign it's going wrong. Your Sun's nakshatra, Punarvasu, is about starting again with wisdom.

Your Lagna lord Mars is strong in its own sign in the 6th, so you have unusual stamina for hard work, competition and problem-solving. Mercury in the 9th ties your intellect to principle, policy and learning, and as lord of your 11th house it turns that knowledge into gains. Gaja Kesari yoga supports reputation built on wisdom and fairness.

Where work gets hard: Saturn, karaka of work, is retrograde in your 2nd house of earnings. Money comes slowly, and you can be anxious about it. The timing makes this louder: you're in the Saturn Antardasha of your Sun Mahadasha (to July 2027), and in the peak of Sade Sati, with Saturn transiting over your Moon sign. This is a heavy, testing stretch that rewards discipline and punishes rushing. Ketu is transiting your 10th house, which can make status feel hollow.

What the timing asks: the Sun Mahadasha (to 2029) wants you to claim your own authority. The Saturn sub-period says do it through structure: build an income base, set terms, take one disciplined step at a time. Jupiter enters your 10th house from 1 November, opening a year of career visibility. Use the next twelve months to lay foundations; Mercury's sub-period from July 2027 favours the gains.

highlights.title: Sun · Surya
highlights.why: Lord of your 10th house of career, in the 8th with Jupiter and Venus. Your career runs through depth, trust and research, changes form more than once, and brings recognition after behind-the-scenes work. It's also the lord of your current Mahadasha.

highlights.title: Current Antardasha
highlights.why: Saturn's sub-period (to July 2027) within the Sun's Mahadasha, during the peak of Sade Sati. A demanding, structured year: build your own base through steady effort. Shortcuts and dramatic leaps are what this period punishes.

highlights.title: Mars · Mangala
highlights.why: Your Lagna lord is strong in its own sign in the 6th house of service and competition. It gives the stamina to outwork problems, and the confidence that you can survive hard conditions. The risk is exhausting yourself proving it.

highlights.title: Mercury · Budha
highlights.why: In the 9th house of principle and learning, and lord of your 11th house of gains. Policy, advice, teaching and writing turn your knowledge into income, especially in the Mercury sub-period from July 2027.

vedic.month.reading:
The most important event of the month for your work comes at the start: Jupiter enters Simha (Leo), your 10th house from the Lagna, on 1 November, and stays for about a year. Jupiter in the 10th from the Lagna is a classic sign of career growth, recognition and new responsibility. From your Moon it falls in the 6th, which warns that the growth comes with more work and some friction, so pace yourself. Mars joins it in your 10th on 13 November, adding drive and willingness to act on career matters.

Venus enters Kanya, your 11th from the Lagna, on 6 November, which helps gains and networks, then moves to your 12th on 23 November, a quieter, more inward few weeks. Mercury and Venus turn direct on 14 November, a better time to finalise plans than the days before it. Avoid starting anything new on 8 November, a Chandrashtama day (the Moon in the 8th from your Moon), when the Tara is also unfavourable. The Sun enters your Lagna on 17 November, putting the spotlight on you.

dates.note: Jupiter enters your 10th house: a year of career growth and visibility begins.
Chandrashtama with an unfavourable Tara: don't start anything new today.
Mars joins Jupiter in your 10th: energy to act on career matters.
Mercury and Venus turn direct: better for finalising plans and agreements.
The Sun enters your Lagna: a good time to put yourself forward.
